messages:
Maria (AE): Quick sync — onboarding call with TenorHealth tomorrow. Need to lock POC scope and success criteria. They want 3 user journeys prioritized, SSO + data residency + pricing confirmation. Can folks weigh in?
Kevin (SE): I can map the endpoints. Do we have their sample payloads? asking for typical doc/chat flows.
Maria (AE): They shared a short spec in the deck — mainly: patient triage chat, discharge summary generation, and insurance eligibility answer endpoint. I'll paste the snippets in a sec.
Kevin (SE): Perfect. For triage chat I'd prioritize realtime latency; for summaries it's throughput and token-cost.
Ashley (PM): Proposed success criteria per journey (draft):
- Triage chat: p95 latency < 500ms for 256-token exchanges; >85% user intent accuracy on our eval set.
- Discharge summary: mean ROUGE-L >= 0.45 on provided label set; 95% of summaries pass basic PHI redaction check.
- Eligibility Q/A: answer precision >= 90% on curated prompts + <5% hallucination rate.
Samir (SRE): Ops checklist: SSO via SAML v2, IP allowlist for staging, VPC peering request timeline (2 weeks), and KMS integration for keys. They'll need audit logs for every inference request.
Priya (Security): Add items: data retention policy (30 days default), ability to purge customer data on request, encryption-in-transit + at-rest, SOC2 + encryption attestation. Also need to confirm whether any PII will be stored in embeddings.
Maria (AE): They asked about prompt/eval plan. Kevin/Ashley — can we propose ~30 representative prompts per journey for the POC? Also need a simple scoring harness.
Kevin (SE): I'll assemble prompts. Draft eval harness: run prompts through staging model + golden answers, compute precision/recall and a small hallucination classifier. Example prompt (triage):
```
Patient: I've had a fever and cough for 3 days and shortness of breath. What should I do?
System: <generate triage response>
```
We should include edge-case prompts for meds allergies and comorbidities.
Ashley (PM): Timeline proposal:
- Day 0: kickoff and data transfer (samples + labels)
- Day 3: config + SSO test credentials exchanged
- Day 7: first model + endpoint up in staging, initial eval run
- Day 14: iterate on prompts, run formal eval against acceptance criteria
- End of Week 4: demo and decision.
Maria (AE): Pricing question from procurement: can we offer a capped pilot rate for the 4-week POC? They expect cost predictability.
Samir (SRE): We can offer a fixed pilot commit for Dedicated-ish capacity in staging. Need to check quota with infra. I'll confirm by EOD.
Priya (Security): Also: please get them to fill the security questionnaire before Day 3. I'll need answers on data flows and third-party processors.
Kevin (SE): For endpoints, here's a minimal matrix I propose:
- /v1/triage -> streaming chat, 256 token limit, KV cache disabled
- /v1/summarize -> batch endpoint, 2048 token, async job support
- /v1/eligibility -> single-turn QA, embedding-based retrieval + rerank
I'll add expected QPS and concurrency in the doc.
Maria (AE): Client asked about model variants and fallback if capacity hits. Can we commit to auto-fallback to a smaller quantized model with identical API?
Samir (SRE): Yes — we can configure routing policy: primary model -> fallback quantized model in same region. Need to document expected quality delta (~3-5% metric drop for summaries).
Ashley (PM): Acceptance checklist to show to the client (short):
1) Endpoints live in staging + SSO validated
2) Eval harness results meeting thresholds (see above)
3) Security questionnaire reviewed and key items signed off
4) Pilot pricing agreed and invoice sent
5) Rollback/escape hatches documented (model fallback + throttling)
Maria (AE): Action items: Kevin: compile 30 prompts per journey + sample payload shapes by EOD. Samir: confirm pilot commit/quota + routing fallback ETA. Priya: send security questionnaire link to TenorHealth and request answers by Day 3. Ashley: finalize acceptance criteria doc and share with client. I'll coordinate kickoff.
Kevin (SE): On it. Will post prompts in the sales drive and link here.
Samir (SRE): I'll ping infra and loop back. Possible blocker: VPC peering has org approvals — might add 5 business days.
Priya (Security): If they have strict data residency (EU only), we need to spin staging in eu-west-1 region; that adds ~48 hours.
Maria (AE): Noted. One last ask from them: can we do a short embedded-retention test to ensure we don't store embeddings by default? They want explicit opt-in.
Kevin (SE): We'll set embeddings write=false by default for the POC and document the toggle.
ops-bot: deploy-staging started for tenorpoc-staging (build 2026.3) :rocket:
Maria (AE): Thanks everyone. I'll update the client after Kevin's prompts land. :thumbsup:
